text: content/theology/crisis-policy.json is the crisis-safety policy. A deterministic crisis layer runs before normal generation for credible first-person suicide or self-harm indicators: immediate danger goes to 911/emergency services; U.S. crisis offers call or text 988; encourage a trusted person present and distance from means; stay conversational. Pastoral response (God's love and presence, prayer alongside human help, referral to trusted clergy, praying on request) is expected, but prayer never replaces or delays urgent help. Prohibited: shame, threats of hell or punishment, implying weak faith, prayer-alone advice, promised healing, silent third-party contact, IP-based identity, permanent risk labels, converting crisis chat into feedback
